GM Fabiano Caruana is now rated exactly 2800.0 on the live rating list after beating GM Vincent Keymer, while GM Magnus Carlsen is just 7.2 rating points from losing his 15-year unbroken streak as world number-one after losing to GM Haik Martirosyan. The Armenian is the surprise leader of Group C of the Total Chess World Championship Tour Pilot 2026, while Caruana leads Group B. GM Alireza Firouzja leads Group A despite mixing up colors and losing his first game to GM Andrew Hong, while GM Maxime Vachier-Lagrave has now defeated three Group D rivals in a row after overcoming GM Hans Niemann.
Day five, which features rounds seven and eight of the Group Stage, is on Saturday, November 14, starting at 9 a.m. ET / 15:00 CET / 7:30 p.m. IST.

GM Liem Le vs. Caruana and Carlsen vs. GM Shakhriyar Mamedyarov on Saturday will be watched not just for Total Chess intrigue but because the world number-one spot will again be on the line.
You can review the event on the Chess24 Twitch or YouTube pages, or on GM Hikaru Nakamura's Kick channel. You can find the games on our dedicated events page.
The live broadcast was hosted by GM David Howell, IMs Jovanka Houska and Anna Rudolf, and WIM Fiona Steil-Antoni.

The Total Chess World Championship Tour Pilot 2026 takes place on November 10-21 at the Anantara New York Palace Hotel in Budapest, Hungary. The event is a trial run for the official event in 2027, which will crown the first FIDE World Combined Champion. The event consists of a round-robin group stage and a knockout combining blitz, rapid, and fast classical time controls. The time control is 3+2 for blitz, 15+10 for rapid, 45+30 for fast classical, and 10 minutes (White) vs. 7 minutes (Black) with a one-second increment starting on move 41 in armageddon.
